question.html:
The radius of a planet is R. An object orbits the planet at a distance R above the surface of the planet. In this orbit, the weight of the object is W. 

What is the percentage change in W when the distance of the object from the surface of the planet is tripled?

  1. 25 %
  2. 50 %
  3. 75 %
  4. 100 %
